{{Quote|Adarians are a stubborn people. Once they've made up their minds, it's almost impossible to change them.|[[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]]|<ref name="GG12" />}}
'''Adarians''' were a species of bipedal [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] from the planet [[Adari]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; although Adari was not believed to be their original [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Adarian-CSWE.jpg|thumb|left|180px|An Adarian]]
A [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species of [[Mammal/Legends|mammalians]], the Adarians had elongated skulls made distinct by the large hole which penetrated it. Lacking ears and noses, their skulls were covered in fine hairs which were very sensitive to sound waves, and their skin was underlaid by glands that allowed them to detect odors. Sharp, bony ridges around their mouths substituted for lips seen in other species. The Adarians had distendable throat pouches; elongating them to emit a loud subsonic call which helped in communication over long distances, reaching over 20 kilometers.<ref name="UAA" />

==Society and culture==
Adarian society was based around a rigid caste system known as [[sceel'sara]]. Their governmental headquarters was the [[Hall of Decisions]] from which the upper tier of society had absolute control over those in lower classes. Operating a [[Adarian government|corporation-like government]], the Adarians boasted that their society had never suffered from civil strife. They had unique, advanced [[Carbon-Ice Drive]] technology which they developed before contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Their native language was [[Adarese]], a written and spoken language; speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] was difficult for the lipless species and was spoken with a heavy accent. Adarian naming conventions included a first name and a family name; some examples included Ador Beldune, Denka Melru, Luur Tenefor and Yeeru Meekel.<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
[[File:Trade_on_the_OITS.jpg|thumb|200px|An Adarian onboard ''[[Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport/Legends|Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport]]''.]]
Discovered circa [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], the Adarians swiftly became a member state of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Remaining loyal to the Republic through the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet bought neutrality during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by supplying the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with extensive resources and retained a seat in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. Located in relative proximity to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], Adarians welcomed outcast [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] troops earning Adari the reputation of being a "refuge planet".<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Staying out of galactic affairs, the planet was annexed by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his [[Thrawn campaign|campaigns]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. When the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] was finally driven from the core, the Adarians joined the Republic, only to be cut off with the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]. When the Republic retook [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and reorganized into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the Adarians quickly joined. Remaining neutral in future wars, the species' homeworld was a member of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] as of [[137 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Adarian in the galaxy==
[[File:Adarian_smuggler.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An Adarian [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].]]
Most Adarians active in the galaxy are scouts under the employ of mining corporations or the Adarian government, searching for mineral-rich planets or moons to exploit. While the higher class have no need to leave the world, some lower class individuals will abandon their homeworld in search of a better existence. Seeing work as [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and joining criminal organizations, the Adari also found work in more prestigious positions.<ref name="UAA" /> One Adarian served as a junior officer in the Republic [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] at the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|Battle]] of [[Sebaddon]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A member of this species was meant to appear in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']] but was cut from the finished film. The species was designed and sculpted from the chest up, and was nicknamed "Hole in the Head".<ref name="SWI67">{{InsiderCite|67|The Ultimate Return of the Jedi Insider's Guide|The Ultimate ''Return of the Jedi'' Insider's Guide}}</ref> The species was first seen in [[Star Wars: The Last Command (comic series)|''The Last Command'' comic]] after being identified by the ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''.
